info.title: Nativ Localization API
info.description: REST operations used by Nativ MCP. Media requests use multipart file uploads; responses may include base64 media.

post.description: Parse a txt/docx/pdf/srt script so TTS can skip speech-to-text.
Speech-to-text for playground audio localization. Unbilled draft step.

Analyze an image or document for cultural sensitivity issues across specified countries.

Accepts:
  - file: Image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) or document (TXT, MD, CSV, JSON, HTML,
          SRT, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF). Audio and video are not supported yet.
  - countries: Optional country names (repeated form fields and/or comma-separated).
               Any world country name is accepted. Defaults to top 30 by GDP.
Returns:
  - {
      "verdict": "SAFE" | "NOT SAFE",
      "affected_countries": [
        {
          "country": "Specific Country Name",
          "issue": "Precise description of the problematic element and why it's inappropriate in this cultural context.",
          "suggestion": "Concrete, actionable recommendation to fix the issue while maintaining creative intent."
        }
      ]
    }

Localize an arbitrary image by replacing its in-image text with approved
translations (powered by gpt-image-2), keeping every non-text element intact.

This is distinct from /image/culturalize (logo localization, gpt-image-1):
that endpoint reproduces a single stylized text, while this one edits a busy
image in place using one or more original->localized text replacements.

Accepts:
  - file: PNG, JPEG, or WebP image file
  - mask: Optional legacy union PNG mask (transparent area = editable)
  - region_masks: Optional repeated PNG masks, one per disconnected region
  - region_replacements: Replacement arrays paired with region_masks
  - mask_required: Fail closed if a caller intended masking but sent none
  - replacements: JSON array of {"original": "...", "translated": "..."} pairs
  - language_code: Target language code
  - context: Optional user instructions / guidance for this localization run
  - rtl: Optional RTL override; omitted auto-enables it for RTL languages
  - output_format: Output format (png, jpeg, webp)
  - tool: Source tool making the request
  - num_images: Number of images to generate (1-5, defaults to 1)
Returns:
  - {
      "images": [{"image_base64": "<generated_image_base64>"}, ...],
      "metadata": {"cost": <total_credits>, "num_images": <number_generated>}
    }

post.description: Localize SRT/ITT in-memory for playground. Optional video is transcribed when no subtitle file is sent.

Intelligent translation with glossary priority and fixed cost of 100 credits.

Accepts:
  - text: the source text to translate
  - language: target language full name (e.g. "French")
  - language_code: optional target language code (e.g. "FR") - if not provided, will be empty
  - source_language: source language name (default: "English")
  - source_language_code: source language code (default: "en")
  - glossary: optional glossary content for priority matching
  - context: optional context to use for the translation
  - image_base64: optional base64-encoded image (raw base64 or data URL) to provide visual context
  - tool: the tool to use for the translation (e.g. "psd-api")
  - formality: optional formality level (very_informal, informal, neutral, formal, very_formal) - if not provided, uses user's default settings
  - include_tm_info: when true, returns TM match score, reference, and rationale
  - backtranslate: when true (and include_tm_info=true), generates backtranslation and AI-powered rationale
  
Returns:
  - { 
      "translated_text": "<intelligent translation>", 
      "metadata": {
        "word_count": <number>,
        "cost": 100
      },
      "tm_match": { ... } // only when include_tm_info=true
      "rationale": "..." // only when include_tm_info=true (AI-powered when backtranslate=true)
      "backtranslation": "..." // only when backtranslate=true
    }
